pages.title: Rain Collector
pages.text: A rain collector reduces dependence on exposed water sources. Protect it and keep spare canteens near your shelter.

pages.title: A Sustainable Shelter
pages.text: Water treatment and temperature control solve different problems. Plan room for both before a horde night makes outdoor work dangerous.

pages.title: Field Tents
pages.text: The Zip-Up Tent provides a compact enclosed shelter with a door you can open and close. The Large Tent trades that enclosure for a much roomier sheltered interior. Sneak-use either deployed tent to pack it for travel.

pages.title: Canopy and Walls
pages.text: The Canopy Tent supplies open overhead cover. Place Canvas Walls around it when the camp needs partitions or a more protected working area. Both tents are recognized as valid Camp Radio shelters when the required equipment is kept inside their sheltered area.
